[Benzinga news, 2026-10-30T15:31:31Z, by staff] Federal Court Denies Novartis's Motion to Dismiss in Misappropriation Lawsuit
A U.S. District Court judge denied motions to dismiss filed by Novartis International AG, allowing a lawsuit alleging the misappropriation of confidential investment strategy information to proceed to discovery.
Chief United States District Judge Laura Taylor Swain denied two motions to dismiss filed by Novartis International AG and its co-defendants in the case Richmond Global Compass Fund Management, LP v. Novartis International AG. The lawsuit alleges that Novartis and its co-defendants misappropriated confidential information and a proprietary ESG investment strategy from the plaintiff. By denying the motions, the court has allowed all claims in the case to move forward to the discovery phase and potential trial.
